mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS comment_id, c.gif_id, c.content, c.user_id, c.like_count, c.created_at, u.nickname, u.avatar, cl.created_at AS liked_at FROM comment_like cl INNER JOIN comment c ON cl.comment_id = c.id INNER JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE cl.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY cl.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
mapper.insert:
INSERT IGNORE INTO comment_like (user_id, comment_id) VALUES
(#{item.userId}, #{item.commentId})
mapper.delete:
DELETE FROM comment_like WHERE (user_id, comment_id) IN
(#{item.userId}, #{item.commentId})
